items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: Barbara had wanted $40. Come back just about a day before we were going to leave, wanted $40 more.

ctx.x: He's the only one who didn't ask me for nothing. I didn't let him have nothing. Barbara had wanted $40. Come back just about a day before we were going to leave, wanted $40 more. Well, we couldn't go to North Goldberg, let me have a thousand dollars. And, we bought my thousands right at the end of the road. So, we had three automobiles. We had a model team, which is authored. And, uh, my convertible price. And, uh, Frank Jackie had this convertible Dodge home. And, uh, we left them. We went all the way to Dallas…
